preconditions.expression: stdin.strip().split() != [] and all(c.isdigit() for c in stdin.strip().split()[0])
preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is a non-empty string representing an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 1000) with no leading zeros.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.strip().split()) == 1 and all(len(line) >= 1 and all(c.islower() for c in line) for line in stdin.strip().split()[1:])
preconditions.description: The remaining lines of stdin are exactly T non-empty strings, each containing only lowercase English letters (1 ≤ |S| ≤ 2e5).
The total length of all strings S across all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() == [str(len([k for k in range(len(S)) if (S[k:] + S[:k]) == (S[k:] + S[:k])[::-1]])) for S in stdin.strip().split()[1:]]
postconditions.description: For each string S in the input, the output contains exactly one line with the count of palindromic cyclic shifts. A cyclic shift is palindromic if it equals its own reverse. The count is computed by checking all possible shifts (0 ≤ k < |S|).
